## Title format
Use a conventional-commits title: `type(scope): summary` with `feat | fix | docs | chore | refactor | perf | test`.

## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

Keep PRs small and focused — one bug or one feature at a time. For UI changes, attach before/after screenshots. For logic changes, explain how a reviewer can verify the fix.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## How Has This Been Tested?
- [ ] Ran `npm test` successfully
- [ ] Verified local AI generation & export workflow
- [ ] Checked API key safety & zero leakage

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-reach areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
